briefing.headline: OpenAI and xAI escalate model releases amid compute crunch

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI race intensifies with multiple frontier releases this month as regulatory scrutiny grows. Major labs push boundaries while security gaps widen.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4-preview with advanced reasoning; Anthropic releases Claude 4 Opus; xAI deploys Grok-3 on expanded Memphis cluster; DeepSeek-V3 gains traction in Asia.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. NIST issues new guidelines on agentic AI risks.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC accelerates 2nm production for NVIDIA Blackwell; Microsoft and Google announce joint $40B data center expansion in Texas.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent systems outpace centralized safety controls by end of 2027?
